mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.enabled, a.credential_generation FROM t_sys_user a WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT a.org_id, b.id, b.number, b.name, b.description FROM t_sys_user_role a INNER JOIN t_sys_role b ON b.id = a.role_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.org_id, b.number, b.id
SELECT a.id, a.username, a.name, a.avatar_attachment_id FROM t_sys_user a WHERE a.id = #{id}
